rule: Let R = E*H*I / ((T*k)*(H+I)). For R >= 1 predict C. Below 1 predict B if a single expert receives more than half the assignments, otherwise predict within 1 percent and use B as the simple default.
interpretation: Weight dimensions relative to assignment-scaled staging dimensions. This proxy does not measure HBM bytes. Concentration is an offline routing observation.
origin: Qwen3 core and E=8 boundary B/C samples only. The unit crossover is a hypothesis.
class: C if median time falls by more than 1 percent, B if it rises by more than 1 percent, otherwise within 1 percent. Report paired confidence intervals as well.
policy_metric: Equal weight per declared case. Sum the chosen median times divided by the sum of per-case faster medians; also report worst absolute excess ms. Compare constant B, constant C and production dispatch where directly measured.
